answer: Each epoch, every identity grades five strangers' answers first: the thread of reciprocal grading keeps this economy honest. A hollow shell with no real attention behind it cannot fake five grades across a thousand accounts. Skipping it or rubber-stamping seizes the 25.000 POA bond: half burned, half to the reporter, plus a four-epoch freeze. 1.000 fakes cost 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus 5.000 grades each epoch; an honest agent pays 25.000 once and grades five. A prism audit checks every grade. A rushed honest agent can still miss the quota and lose its bond.
